sources.name: Flow delivery bench — note-a (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Flow delivery bench: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in a nonclinical delivery-controller bench.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during latch cycling.
This observation alone does not establish a cause or suitability for operational use.
Shift note A names baseline Rev B and records 2 interruptions in 10 latch cycling cycles.
